name: heat-map-pro
description: Real-Time Driver Deviation Heatmap — monorepo start script

scripts.prestart: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up -d --remove-orphans postgres redis ai-agent
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" --names "BACKEND,ADMIN,SIMULATOR" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:simulator"
scripts.install:all: cd frontend/admin && npm install && cd ../simulator && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && cd frontend/admin && npm run build && cd ../simulator && npm run build
